issue.title: Mermaid PDF tests read compressed PDF bytes as text when pdftotext is absent

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Repeated by phases 99.1, 99.2, 99.4 on unchanged code and independently at 47036193: cargo test --lib diagrams_ reports 8 passed/2 failed in 13.39s. diagrams_swap_pdf_error_keeps_note_and_source searches compressed PDF bytes for visible source text; diagrams_absent_results_match_unhooked_pdf compares different raw PDFs as text. command -v pdftotext finds no binary. Both pdf_haystack helpers (src/native/highlights_ref/create.rs:4549 and tests/cli/highlights/diagrams.rs:56) deliberately fall back to String::from_utf8_lossy on the PDF file when pdftotext is unavailable or fails. That is not a valid text extraction and also allows false passing negative assertions. Require/gate real text extraction for text assertions, or supply an honest supported extractor; keep pure contract tests running. Verify the missing-tool path and the normal extractor path. The same helper explains the five CLI Mermaid failures reported by 99.2; rerun that family and record actual node IDs. These helpers came from closed epic bob-cli-8y, not an active epic. The distinct lifted-link failure stays with active bob-cli-87.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-99.1 note 2 and 99.2 note 3 proposed repeated clean-base Mermaid failures, also confirmed by 99.4. Landing traced their shared test-only fallback to missing pdftotext on apollo; this is unrelated to the Reading Board.

evidence.note: Relayed by bob-cli-9j.land from bob-cli-9j.1 note 2: just check at 5ec1390e showed the same clean-base Mermaid PDF text failures, with pdftotext absent on apollo. Later, b9788c45 (bob-cli-9j.2) gated both skip_pandoc_xelatex helpers (src/native/highlights_ref/create.rs and tests/cli/highlights/diagrams.rs) on pdftotext, so on 930b3495 'cargo test --lib -- diagrams_ lifted pandoc_maps_every_contract_construct_to_tex' passes 11/11 by skipping. The String::from_utf8_lossy fallback in pdf_haystack (create.rs:4552) is still present, and pure contract tests now skip with the extractor tests, so the remedy described here (gate only the text assertions and drop the lossy fallback) is still open.

payload.description: Another test that depends on a host tool (pdftotext); fix both together before adding clean-runner CI
Need task bead baseline for mermaid pdftotext phase
Need target task scope and status for epic landing

payload.entry: Fixed by 3eebe47f (batch-10 phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.4) and ba523746 (lander). The String::from_utf8_lossy raw-PDF fallback is gone from all three pdf_haystack helpers (create.rs, note_snapshot/profile.rs, tests/cli/highlights/diagrams.rs). Text assertions now require pdftotext and skip with a reason when it is missing. skip_real_diagram_render gained the pdftotext gate. ba523746 resolves the +1's remaining point: only the text-asserting CLI tests are pdftotext-gated, and the render-only no-Mermaid and scale-warning tests run without it. pandoc_maps_every_contract_construct_to_tex needs only pandoc. Lander verification with pdftotext hidden from PATH: lib diagrams_/tall_/short_diagram 19/19 and CLI highlights::diagrams 12/12 pass. With pdftotext present, just check passes: 18 suites, 5657 passed, 0 failed.
